title: Fourier expansion on an affine subspace
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\mathbb{R}$, let $H$ be a linear subspace of $\mathbb{F}_2^n$, and let $z\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. The uniform average of $f(h+z)$ over $h\in H$ equals $\sum_{\gamma\in H^\perp}\chi_\gamma(z)\widehat f(\operatorname{supp}\gamma)$, where $H^\perp$ is the orthogonal subspace, $\chi_\gamma$ is the Walsh character indexed by $\gamma$, and $\widehat f(U)$ is the Fourier coefficient indexed by $U\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$.
